description: Rank-only grayscale crops of public playing-card artwork, and photos if present. Gray pixels are zlib-compressed then base64-encoded; PNG metadata is excluded. Holdouts are excluded from exemplar selection.

letele.credit: letele, based on the SVG playing cards by Adrian Kennard

furby.credit: Full Deck Of Ornate Playing Cards - English by j4p4n, deck PNGs packaged by Jack Furby
